discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Recent prizes covered machine learning (2024) and macroscopic quantum tunnelling in circuits (2025), which leaves room for a core condensed-matter topic. Topological insulators are a mature field with very high impact. Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state, and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells gave the first experimental confirmation. Shoucheng Zhang has died and cannot be awarded, so this trio is the most likely set of recipients.
